translations.translatedText: An earthquake has happened on the Greek island of Kos. In Lapinjärvi, meetings are held for children of refugee families, where they make food together. In Mustasaari a new kind of home for the elderly has been built. Finns have been doing Nordic walking for 20 years. The weather.
